nodes.short_description:
Color-A-Cube é um jogo de colorir acolhedor em VR centrado em interações simples e satisfatórias de colorir por números. 
Escolhe a partir de uma biblioteca crescente de mais de 100 modelos voxel, pega no teu pincel virtual e colore cada cenário cubo a cubo com cliques nítidos, sons alegres e efeitos brilhantes. 
Desenhado para curtas pausas relaxantes os sessões criativas mais longas, o jogo oferece um fluxo calmante de "só mais um cubo" que é fácil de começar e estranhamente difícil de largar.

Color-A-Cube es un acogedor juego de colorear en VR basado en un sencillo y satisfactorio "pintar por números". Elige entre más de 100 modelos voxel, agarra tu pincel virtual y colorea cada escena cubo a cubo con clics nítidos y alegres efectos brillantes. Pensado para descansos relajantes o largas sesiones creativas, el juego ofrece un flujo calmante de "solo un cubo más" que es muy fácil de empezar y extrañamente difícil de soltar.

Color-A-Cube è un accogliente gioco di colorazione in VR basato su interazioni semplici e gratificanti di "colorazione con i numeri". 
Scegli da una libreria in continua crescita di oltre 100 modelli voxel, afferra il tuo pennello virtuale e colora ogni scena cubo dopo cubo tra clic precisi, allegri pop ed effetti scintillanti.
 Progettato per brevi pause rilassanti o sessioni creative più lunghe, il gioco offre un flusso calmante del "manca solo un cubo" facile da iniziare e stranamente diffici

Plongez dans une escapade relaxante et colorée avec Color-A-Cube.
Cette expérience de coloriage gratuite et immersive vous permet de colorier des modèles voxel, cube par cube, avec des effets sonores et luminueux qui rendent chaque étape gratifiante.
Facile à prendre en main, difficile à lâcher.
Découvrez une bibliothèque grandissante de modèles uniques, avec de nouvelles créations à colorier et à collectionner chaque mois.

Farbe-einen-Würfel ist ein cozy VR-Malspiel mit einfachem „Malen nach Zahlen“. Wähl aus über 100 Voxel-Modellen, schnapp dir den virtuellen Pinsel und male Szenen Würfel für Würfel an, mit knackigen Klicks und funkelnden Effekten. Egal, ob du nur für ein paar Minuten spielst oder dich für eine längere kreative Session einrichtest: du wirst die Zeit komplett vergessen

Color-A-Cube is een gezellige VR-game die draait om ontspannen 'kleuren op nummer'. Kies uit meer dan 100 voxelmodellen en kleur ze kubus voor kubus in met vrolijke visuele -en geluidseffecten. Of je nu kiest voor een korte pauze of een lange creatieve sessie: de rustgevende "nog één kubus dan"-flow is zo ontworpen dat je makkelijk begint, maar de game verrassend lastig weglegt.

Color-A-Cube is a cozy VR coloring game built around simple, satisfying color-by-number interactions. Pick from a growing library of 100+ voxel models, grab your virtual brush, and color each scene cube by cube with crisp clicks, happy pops, and sparkling effects. Designed for short relaxing breaks or longer creative sessions, the game offers a calming “just one more cube” flow that is easy to start and strangely hard to put down.

'Color-A-Cube'는 단순하지만 기분 좋은 '숫자별 컬러링' 상호작용을 기반으로 한 아늑한 VR 색칠 게임입니다.
 100개 이상으로 계속 늘어나는 복셀 모델 라이브러리에서 원하는 모델을 고르고 가상 붓을 쥔 뒤, 선명한 클릭 소리, 통통 튀는 팝 효과, 반짝이는 이펙트와 함께 각 장면을 큐브 단위로 채워나가세요.
 짧은 휴식이나 긴 창작 시간 모두에 어울리도록 디자인되었으며, "딱 한 칸만 더" 채우고 싶어지는 편안한 몰입감을 선사해 시작하긴 쉽지만 멈추기는 묘하게 어렵습니다.

Color-A-Cube — уютная VR-игра, где вы раскрашиваете по номерам более 100 воксельных моделей. Берите виртуальную кисть и красьте сцены кубик за кубиком под приятные щелчки и яркие эффекты. Игра идеальна как для коротких перерывов, так и для долгих сессий. Её расслабляющий поток в духе «ну ещё один кубик» максимально прост в освоении, но от него на удивление тяжело оторваться.

《Color-A-Cube》是一款围绕简单、充满满足感的“数字涂色”互动而设计的温馨VR游戏。
从包含100多个不断增加的的体素模型库中随心挑选，拿起你的虚拟画笔，伴随着清脆的点击声、欢快的砰砰声和闪烁的特效，逐个方块为场景着色。
无论你是想在短暂的休息时间放松一下，还是准备享受一段漫长的创作时光，游戏自带的“再涂一个方块就收手”的奇妙魔力，都能让你轻松上手，却又欲罢不能。

nodes.long_description:
**Dive** into a **relaxing**, **color-filled** escape with Color A Cube. This immersive coloring experience lets you bring voxel worlds to life, one cube at a time. Discover unique themes and models, with new content inspired by our community!

{560028636645784}
**Claim** your first pack **for free!** Download now and choose from:

- Fantasy Pack
- Animal Pack
- Sci-Fi Pack

Each of these packs has unique and fun models for you to paint!

{1143127904042401}{8799122136832134}
**Unwind** and **relax** as you paint vibrant voxel environments and characters. Enjoy the process, discover hidden details, and find calm in every voxelated corner.
{426619937211884}{1080121970080651}
With the Meta Quest 3 lineup, you can choose to play in either Mixed Reality (MR) or Virtual Reality (VR). Paint your models your way—whether you're sitting or standing, the experience is tailored to your comfort and creativity!
{481204747741603}

We’re dedicated to keeping the game fresh, exciting, and constantly improving shaped in part by your valuable feedback!

- A steady stream of new content
- Difficulty levels
- New modes
- Diorama's to showcase your creations
- Extended shop
- More to be revealed!

# Why Early Access?

We’re launching in early access to involve our community in shaping the game. Your feedback will help us refine features, add content, and create the best experience possible! Join our Discord server to share your ideas, report bugs, and participate in discussions.
